comment: Test D of docs/pedal-research/animated-covers.md: can an effect trigger screen redraws itself? While on, it inverts a band in its own cover every 0.5 s and asks the firmware to redraw (MS-70CDR 2.10 Event_post, UI event bit 0x40) -- only after checking the firmware's code bytes and the event handle. Knob 1 shows a clock, knob 2 whether the check passed. Audio passes through.

params.name: Clock
params.comment: Value text: TSCL >> 24 in hex; moves by itself only if redraws are being triggered.

params.name: Check
params.comment: Value text: OK if the firmware check passed (redraws are requested), NO if not (nothing is called).
